mapper.select: SELECT p.user_id AS userId, p.balance FROM payment p JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MAX(payment_date) AS latest_date FROM payment GROUP BY user_id ) AS latest_payments ON p.user_id = latest_payments.user_id AND p.payment_date = latest_payments.latest_date
SELECT SUM(deposit) AS totalDeposit, SUM(withdrawal) AS totalWithdrawal, SUM(CASE WHEN is_purchased = true THEN withdrawal ELSE 0 END) AS totalWithdrawalPurchased FROM payment

SELECT DATE(payment_date) AS paymentDate, SUM(deposit) AS totalDeposit, SUM(CASE WHEN is_purchased = 1 THEN withdrawal ELSE 0 END) AS totalWithdrawal FROM payment GROUP BY DATE(payment_date) ORDER BY paymentDate;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (user_id, deposit, withdrawal, balance, is_purchased) VALUES (#{userId}, #{deposit}, #{withdrawal}, #{balance}, #{isPurchased})
mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, balance FROM payment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY payment_date DESC LIMIT 1
